src/kotoba-client-runtime.js.reason: KOTOBA-158: the consent dialog's close listener denied whatever request was pending, so a late close event from an already-approved request auto-denied the next operation. The host now counts the closes it issues and ignores the matching events; an external close still denies. KOTOBA-159 (independent review findings 2, 4, 5, 6): only headers and body are taken from the caller's init, the sent Request is rebuilt from its URL with mode cors and cache no-store, and method-override headers are refused; a prefix route refuses `;` in the path; connect-src lists HTTP endpoint origins only; connect-src validates and reads one frozen copy of the descriptor. KOTOBA-159 finding 3 (owner decision 2026-10-31): Allow is disabled and does not count until the dialog has been showing for 600 ms, and then only for a trusted pointerdown or Enter/Space keydown on Allow that starts after that; the delay restarts for each request. KOTOBA-159: guest close interrupts request-body snapshot and pending consent, prevents later dispatch and signals in-flight fetch; a completed subsequent iframe navigation also closes the session; navigation start and already-started actions remain outside that guarantee. Nothing else in the file changes. KOTOBA-159: observe host DOM removals and abort detached sessions; require a connected container in the host document outside shadow DOM. Observation is asynchronous and does not reverse dispatched operations. KOTOBA-159: session abort also interrupts bounded guest response-body reads. JUN-751: accept memory as an explicit volatile local-state adapter; no operation or consent semantics change.
